WHICH_SPLIT_THE_ASSEMBLY_SCORES_FROM_AND.why: a RULED FORWARD DAY is not trained on. Every row is a SCORE row that the PINNED heads score at their PINNED thetas to produce `asm`; nothing is fitted here.
